children: Egyptian developer Tatweer Misr has signed a strategic partnership with the Egyptian Armed Forces Land Projects Authority (AFLPA) to develop a 150-feddan land plot in Mostakbal City.
Under the partnership, Tatweer Misr will develop an integrated residential community on the site, supported by a range of amenities and facilities, the company said in a statement.

The agreement was signed by Tatweer Misr Co-Founder, President and CEO Ahmed Shalaby and representatives of AFLPA at a ceremony hosted by MIDAR for Investment and Urban Development, the master developer of Mostakbal City.
The project is planned as an integrated urban community catering to different residential segments.
The statement didn’t disclose project name, value or delivery schedule.
(Writing by Eman Hamed; Editing by Anoop Menon)
